meta.source: Understat shot-level data (own xG model, NOT Opta)
meta.box_definition: x >= 0.843, 0.2035 <= y <= 0.7965 (penalty area in Understat normalised pitch coordinates)
meta.note: Understat runs its own xG model, so these numbers do not match Opta's and must never be labelled as Opta. Penalties are excluded from npxG. Own goals are not counted as shots.
